**Install:** download `PetTracker-Setup-*.exe` below and run it. You need [Npcap](https://npcap.com/#download) installed (it comes with Wireshark). Start Pet Tracker before you log into your character.

`PetTracker.exe` is the same app without the installer (portable).

See the [README](https://github.com/caiooncoding/aion-pet-tracker#readme) for how it works.
